about: The cast iron skillet as the skeleton holds it, first and third person (Cooking V1 K1a, docs/gameplay/cooking_v1_plan.md 7). Points, bounds: item block units of the skillet mesh as client/AflStaticMeshItemClient draws it (meshes/cast_iron_skillet.aflmesh.json + (0.5, 0.236482, 0.5), 1 px = 1 cm, an item unit 16 cm; the pan's axis at x -6.32 cm, the handle along +x). Scale 0.24: 1.5 x real size (the held size rule of 2026-10-27), 76 cm long with the handle. grip: the middle of the handle; center: the middle of the pan's floor.
